name: Café Sabor Chicken Tortilla Soup (Broth & Chicken Mod) vs. Chips & Salsa
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Warm shredded chicken, rice, and fresh avocado slices in broth are much gentler than basket chips with raw tomato-jalapeño salsa, though the broth still contains tomato/chili seasoning and a touch of lime.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Chicken Tortilla Soup with shredded chicken, rice, Jack cheese, and fresh avocado slices, holding the fried tortilla strips and lime wedge.
watchOuts: Contains citrus (lime juice in broth/guacamole) and mild chili seasoning—citrusFree is false
